items.title: Awesome Integration
items.content_text:
### Projects / API Management

*   [Gravitee.io API Management (⭐377) (⭐376)](https://github.com/gravitee-io/gravitee-api-management) - A lightweight, open-source platform offering flexible API governance, robust security, and straightforward configuration.
*   [WSO2 API Manager (⭐964) (⭐962)](https://github.com/wso2/product-apim) - A fully open-source API platform offering robust governance, flexible deployment, and community-driven innovation.

### Projects / API Documentation

*   [OpenAPI Explorer (⭐343) (⭐342)](https://github.com/Rhosys/openapi-explorer) - Creates intuitive, interactive user interfaces from OpenAPI specs, simplifying API exploration and testing.
*   [Zudoku (⭐443) (⭐441)](https://github.com/zuplo/zudoku) - A customizable framework built on OpenAPI, focused on delivering exceptional developer experiences through quality documentation.

### Projects / Data Integration

*   [Pentaho Data Integration (⭐8.3k) (⭐8.3k)](https://github.com/pentaho/pentaho-kettle) - Intuitive, visual ETL tool that simplifies data ingestion, blending, and cleansing across multiple sources without heavy coding.

### Projects / Message Broker

*   [Centrifugo (⭐9.9k) (⭐9.9k)](https://github.com/centrifugal/centrifugo) - Scalable real-time messaging server that minimizes delay in delivering events to online users.
*   [LavinMQ (⭐853) (⭐850)](https://github.com/cloudamqp/lavinmq) - High-performance message queue server implementing AMQP 0-9-1 and MQTT protocols, built with Crystal for exceptional throughput and minimal resource usage.

### Resources / Data Formats

*   [YAML (⭐451) (⭐450)](https://github.com/yaml/yaml-spec) - A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.

items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [ash (⭐6)](https://github.com/NotNanook/Ash) - A no-bullshit, seamless way to use LLMs right inside your shell (`bash`, `zsh`). Supports OpenAI, Ollama and OpenRouter.
*   [ask-opencode (⭐1)](https://github.com/andreacasarin/zsh-ask-opencode) - Integrates OpenCode AI with your shell, allowing you to generate shell commands using natural language. Press `Ctrl+O` to transform any text in your command line into optimized shell commands.
*   [fnm (sukkaw) (⭐2)](https://github.com/SukkaW/zsh-fnm) - Provides enhancement to the Node.js version manager [`fnm`](https://fnm.vercel.app).

### Completions / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [skate-actions (⭐0)](https://github.com/mjmccull0/skate-actions) - Tab completions for [skate (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/charmbracelet/skate) personal key-value store.
